categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Meiteng Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent equipment and intelligent systems & instruments for industrial and mining sectors. Its core business includes smart dry coal sorting equipment (TDS, XRT, MDS), intelligent jigging systems (TGS), and wet coal sorting equipment (DCG, TCS, flotation). The company also provides intelligent systems such as production management, intelligent dispatching, industrial IoT platforms, and various intelligent instruments like X-ray induced ash analyzers. Additionally, it has expanded into recycling and resource recovery, including lithium battery recycling and metal recovery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including X-ray transmission for material classification, high-precision image recognition and segmentation, precise pneumatic ejection technology, gradient fluidization sorting, and two-phase fluid interference sedimentation models. It integrates FPGA-based high-speed data acquisition and processing, neural network-based computer vision, digital twin modeling, and machine learning algorithms for process control. Production follows a make-to-order model with ERP-managed manufacturing and includes both hardware assembly and software development for intelligent systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Meiteng serves primarily large and medium-sized coal mining enterprises and coal preparation plants in China, with expanding presence in non-coal mining sectors such as phosphate, lead-zinc, copper, and other minerals. Key customers include major energy groups like Shandong Energy Group, National Energy Investment Group, and Shanxi Coking Coal Group. The company also targets overseas markets including Mongolia, Indonesia, Australia, South Africa, and Central Asia, focusing on coal and mineral sorting and intelligent mining solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in North China, Northwest, Northeast, East China, Central China, and Southwest regions. It has begun international expansion with orders and installations in Mongolia, Indonesia, and Australia. The company has established an intelligent dry sorting test center in New South Wales, Australia, to support overseas market development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meiteng operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial and mining supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent sorting equipment and systems. It also provides operational services including mineral processing and plant operation, positioning itself as a technology and solution provider rather than raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in intelligent dry sorting technology, expanding mineral types sorted and improving sorting precision and capacity. R&D priorities include development of intelligent instruments, digital twin models, unmanned loading systems, and intelligent decision-making platforms. It invests heavily in core component self-development to reduce costs and enhance competitiveness. The strategic focus includes deepening coal industry penetration, expanding into mining and industrial sectors, and developing recycling and resource recovery technologies, especially lithium battery recycling.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent equipment and systems, including customized solutions for coal and mineral sorting. The company also earns income from operational services such as mineral processing and plant management. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales channels, supplemented by distributors for spare parts and some instruments. Additionally, the company leverages government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Meiteng holds a leading position in the domestic intelligent dry coal sorting market, with the TDS machine having the highest market share in coal gangue sorting. It is recognized for technological leadership in difficult-to-sort coal and mineral types, with competitive advantages in sorting precision, processing capacity, and stability. The company faces increasing competition from domestic and international entrants in the intelligent sorting and smart mining sectors, with price competition intensifying. However, Meiteng maintains differentiation through continuous R&D and integrated intelligent system offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Meiteng achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 570 million, a 16.49% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 74.2 million, a 40.39% decrease due to increased R&D and sales expenses and reduced government subsidies. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.82 billion with net assets of RMB 1.49 billion, reflecting steady growth. R&D investment accounted for 12.06% of revenue, highlighting a strong commitment to innovation. The company’s cash flow from operations was negative due to increased receivables and inventory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meiteng emphasizes its advanced intelligent sorting technologies that enable high-precision, high-capacity, and stable sorting of coal and a wide range of minerals, including difficult-to-sort ores. Its products support energy-saving, low-carbon, and environmentally friendly mining aligned with national carbon neutrality goals. The company offers integrated intelligent systems and digital twin solutions that enhance operational efficiency and automation in mining and coal preparation. Its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core components, and comprehensive service offerings differentiate it from competitors and provide customers with tailored, high-value solutions.
